output.title: Aerobic Foundation & Flat Strides
output.description: Process: Warm up 15 min easy @ Zone 1-2 → 35 min steady Zone 2 running → 5 x 20s flat strides with 60s walking rest → Cool down 5 min easy jog. Overall: An aerobic maintenance session with short neuromuscular strides to kick off the training block. This establishes baseline aerobic volume without accumulating systemic fatigue. Reason: Scheduled on the initial plan day to assess movement quality and re-engage neuromuscular firing without terrain stress. Benefit: Promotes capillary density and stroke volume while neuromuscular strides preserve leg turnover and running economy. Warning: Keep strides relaxed at roughly 90-95% perceived speed rather than an all-out sprint to safeguard hamstrings.
output.fueling_tip: Sessions < 75 mins: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); no exogenous carbs needed.

output.title: Bodyweight Muscular Endurance Soft-Start
output.description: Process: Warm up 15 min easy aerobic running building to Zone 3 for the final 2 min → 10 get-ups from lying on the floor → 10 burpees → Split Jump Squats: 4x10/leg at ~1 jump/s, 60s rest between sets → Squat Jumps: 4x10, 60s rest between sets → Box Step-Ups at 75% kneecap height: 4x10/leg (all right leg, then all left), ~1 rep/s, 30s rest between sets → Front Lunges: 4x10/leg, ~1 rep/s, 30s rest between sets → Cool down 10 min easy aerobic jog. Overall: Initial soft-start gym-style muscular endurance circuit performed with bodyweight only to prepare the legs for high mountain vertical demands. By keeping the load strictly local, it conditions type I and IIa fibers against fatigue without cardiac strain. Reason: With 10 weeks before the ME cutoff and lacking outdoor hills, ME must begin immediately to simulate the 2,500m of race climbing. Benefit: Drastically increases local muscular fatigue resistance and eccentric quad tolerance, preventing late-race quad collapse. Warning: Do not rush through reps; maintain deliberate cadence and pause if form degrades. Do not add external weight during this initial soft-start session.
output.fueling_tip: Sessions < 75 mins: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); no exogenous carbs needed.

output.title: Recovery Day
output.description: Process: Complete full rest day with optional light mobility and foam rolling. Overall: Dedicated complete rest to absorb Thursday's muscular endurance stimulus. Reason: Protects the critical 48-hour buffer following ME work to allow peripheral muscle tissue remodeling. Benefit: Restores glycogen stores and repairs microtrauma in quad and hip musculature. Warning: Avoid strenuous cross-training or heavy domestic lifting to ensure true physical recovery.
output.fueling_tip: Sessions < 75 mins: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); no exogenous carbs needed.

output.title: Aerobic Base Volume Run
output.description: Process: Warm up 10 min easy jog @ Zone 1 → 50 min steady aerobic running @ Zone 2 → Cool down 5 min easy walking. Overall: Continuous low-intensity aerobic run focused strictly on fat oxidation and movement efficiency. Reason: Adds necessary weekly volume while adhering to the 48-hour separation buffer from Thursday's ME session. Benefit: Expands mitochondrial network and increases aerobic enzyme activity in slow-twitch muscle fibers. Warning: Strictly enforce the aerobic threshold ceiling of 148 bpm; back off pace immediately if heart rate drifts upward.
output.fueling_tip: Sessions < 75 mins: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); no exogenous carbs needed.

output.title: Aerobic Base Long Run
output.description: Process: Warm up 10 min progressive Zone 1 jog → 70 min steady Zone 2 long run holding consistent cadence → Cool down 5 min walking. Overall: Foundational long run executed strictly within Zone 2 on flat terrain to develop endurance capacity. Reason: Base-phase long run building structural integrity and aerobic stamina capped under 30% of weekly volume. Benefit: Improves fatty acid utilization efficiency and strengthens connective tissue for multi-hour trail demands. Warning: Do not surge on slight road rises; keep breathing conversational and heart rate securely below 148 bpm.
output.fueling_tip: Sessions 75-150 mins: 30-60g carbohydrates per hour + 300-500mg sodium/hr with 400-600ml water/hr.
